notes.title: New Year's Update
notes.content:
"Yes, I am still alive."

Even though I'm pretty much done with this game (which I have said before), it is fun to add stuff to The Rush once and a while to supplement my other projects. Here's what this update brings...

- Rebalanced a number of boss attacks in regards to difficulty scaling and bullet speeds
- Added a new attack to the Stage 1 Boss to prevent graze milking
- Made Paylo drop a points capsule on death
- Reduced the time it takes for a weapon capsule to convert into a points capsule by 8 seconds
- Resprited Mr. Membrane
- Fixed a bug with the displayed achievement badges on the Arcade Mode select screen
- Added an achievement badge for the "Technical Monkey" achievement
- Added a "Slowdown" setting, which when enabled causes the game's fps to drop when many bullets and enemies are in play (off by default)
- Added a new achievement correlating to a secret in Stage 5

Thank you to anyone reading this, and to anybody who has stuck with The Rush!

notes.title: Additional Fixes & Polish... For Now...
notes.content:
I know it may appear that "real content" isn't being added in any of these post launch updates, but that's because nobody is supposed to know about the secret stage I'm almost done with!

Among relatively minute tweaks, some larger changes include:

- New music tracks when practicing each of the stages
- Stage 2 is less claustrophobic and hopefully a bit easier
- Dramatic Fixes to the overall DPS of "piercing" attacks against bosses (such as bomb explosions & the 2nd or 4th boss weapons)

[P.S. I was doing some back-end fixes, so tell me if you encounter any crashes or bugs in relation to pausing the game. Thank you all so much for even bothering to read my updates.]

notes.title: Final Early Access Update
notes.content: I am so close to release I can just taste it! This update adds an actual functioning ending, complete with (rather short) credits. Thanks to everybody who has been playing The Rush so far! Some bugs were also fixed, and new sounds were added among other minute changes. Once I do a bit more polishing and make more achievements I will take the game out of Early Access purgatory for good! Remember to voice any opinions you have on the game. I will definitely still update The Rush after release with both fixes and new content, so don't worry if you find some game-breaking bug...

notes.title: Practice Makes Perfect Update
notes.content:
As the name would suggest, the main feature if this update is a fully functioning practice mode to prepare yourself for that 1CC (which is still technically impossible by the way). Other notable changes include...

- The first two phases of the final boss are functional, but the game will crash after the second phase...
- Most bosses have some i-frames as they spawn for balancing purposes
- Stage 4 received a dramatic visual overhaul
- Option Punch has slightly reduced DPS
- Machine Gun has higher overall DPS
- Sound effect and mixing tweaks
- Back-end code improvements nobody cares about
- A new stage 3 theme (don't worry, the old one will come back)
- Nerfs to certain bosses at varying difficulty levels
- The 6th boss now drops a life as compensation for not having a weapon
- Visual improvements to tracking bullets
- Minor checkpoint alterations
- Sprite adjustments for increased visual clarity (such as subtle flashing for projectiles)

Thanks for your continued interest in The Rush!
